note: Per-spec defensive table powering the tank death post-mortem (analysis/tank_death.py). Cooldowns are BASELINE values and are talent-, tier- and patch-sensitive; the engine treats them as an estimate and refuses to claim 'available and unused' when the evidence is weak (see tank_death.py's confidence rules). Spell ids are the stable part and are the thing to trust here. Same discipline as gamedata.DEFENSIVES: every entry is one believed accurate, and anything shakier carries its own note rather than being presented as fact.

verified.against: LibOpenRaid ThingsToMantain_Midnight.lua (standalone and Details!-bundled copies agree on every disputed entry)
verified.result: 26 of 46 match; 10 not tracked by LibOpenRaid (rotational/resource-gated buttons); 10 disagree. LibOpenRaid itself has errors (Shield Wall cooldown and duration swapped; Rune Tap under Unholy), so disagreements were resolved by rule rather than by adopting either side: the value that can only suppress a claim wins. In-game tooltip verification is still the only ground truth.

defensives.name: Anti-Magic Shell
defensives.note: Duration 10s per LibOpenRaid (was 5s here); the longer value is kept because it can only make 'was holding it' more likely, never an accusation.

defensives.name: Rune Tap
defensives.note: Costs a rune, so resource-gated: usage only since 2026-09-23. LibOpenRaid lists this under Unholy (252), which is wrong -- it is Blood.

defensives.name: Death Strike
defensives.note: Resource-gated, not on a cooldown; tracked for usage only, never scored as 'available and unused'.

defensives.name: Demon Spikes
defensives.note: Charge count is talent-dependent in 12.x; the engine does not score charges, only 'was it used'.

defensives.name: Darkness
defensives.note: LibOpenRaid lists Darkness for Havoc (577) only, with a talented 180s cooldown; the untalented 300s is kept here.

defensives.name: Ironfur
defensives.note: Rage-gated and stacking; tracked for usage only, never scored as 'available and unused'.

defensives.name: Frenzied Regeneration
defensives.note: Believed to cost rage in 12.x, unverified here; usage only since 2026-09-23 so an unconfirmed resource gate can never produce a false claim.

defensives.name: Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc
defensives.note: Talent; absent builds simply never cast it, which the engine treats as 'not in this build' rather than unused.

defensives.name: Fortifying Brew
defensives.note: Brewmaster's cooldown is reduced by talent; baseline here is the untalented class value. Verified 2026-09-23 against LibOpenRaid (Midnight data): it has 420s for Brewmaster where this table had 360s. Disagreements are resolved to the value that can only suppress a claim, never create one -- the longer cooldown.

defensives.name: Diffuse Magic
defensives.note: Talent. LibOpenRaid lists Diffuse Magic for Windwalker/Mistweaver only; same safe failure as above if Brewmaster lacks it.

defensives.name: Shield of the Righteous
defensives.note: Holy Power-gated; tracked for usage only, never scored as 'available and unused'.

defensives.name: Divine Protection
defensives.note: LibOpenRaid lists Divine Protection for Holy (65) only; if Protection no longer has it, it is simply never cast and never claimed.

defensives.name: Shield Block
defensives.note: Rage-gated as well as charge-gated; usage only. (cooldown_s was 16 until 2026-09-23, which contradicted this note and made it scorable.)

defensives.name: Last Stand
defensives.note: 12.1 reportedly reworked this (possibly passive, triggered by Shield Wall). Unverified against a live client -- if it no longer appears as its own cast, it simply never scores, which is the safe failure mode.
